lines.speaker: Dina
lines.text: Hi, I'm Dina, the head of support.

lines.speaker: Victor
lines.text: And I'm Victor, the technical writer on the team.

lines.speaker: Dina
lines.text: Let's sort out the move to the new help centre.

lines.speaker: Victor
lines.text: I'll export all the current articles by Thursday.

lines.speaker: Dina
lines.text: Good. Victor, can you also rewrite the billing guide?

lines.speaker: Victor
lines.text: And I'll set up the redirects from the old pages.

lines.speaker: Dina
lines.text: Maybe we could record a short video for each article, too.

lines.speaker: Victor
lines.text: Let's hold off on that until the move is done.

lines.speaker: Victor
lines.text: About the export. Thursday is tight, I have the audit. Can we say Monday?

lines.speaker: Dina
lines.text: Yes, Monday is fine with me.

lines.speaker: Dina
lines.text: Someone also needs to warn the customers before the old links break.

lines.speaker: Victor
lines.text: Do we keep the old help centre online as a backup?

lines.speaker: Dina
lines.text: I'm not sure yet. Nobody has decided that.

lines.speaker: Dina
lines.text: Oh, and the platform team will handle the redirects themselves, so you can drop that one.
